Investigate a Payslip with a Warning or Wrong Amount

User manual · English · 8 steps
Learn how to investigate a payslip that shows a warning or an unexpected amount: open the payslip, check the worked days it is based on, and open the employee's work entries to find and correct the cause before recomputing.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Payslips menu

Open the Payslips menu.

3. All Payslips

Click All Payslips.

4. Open a batch

Click a batch name to show its payslips.

5. Open the payslip

Click the payslip to open it.

6. Worked days and inputs

Click the Worked Days & Inputs tab.

7. Work Entries

Click Work Entries to see the employee's attendance and leave records.

8. Correct and recompute

Review the entries, then click the search bar to finish.
